title: 4KPHIL. shares a new track "What a Day Pt. 2"
htmlContent:
4KPHIL. shares a new track called "What a Day Pt. 2," a raw energy sound for the world to rock to on his new song. It features a catchy, smooth and down to earth sound for everyone to enjoy. 4KPHIL. has so much on his mind, but let’s it out through his music.

His attention to detail is strong, and it shows on each of the hooks. “What a Day Pt. 2” is a fire record that shows 4KPHIL. versatility and willingness to push for new heights.
